page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top right. Page number at top left. Heading "INFINITIVVS." centred below the running head. A list of infinitive forms, Latin labels left and Greek forms right. Heading "PARTICIPIVM." centred. Below it a two-part table: left column of masculine, feminine and neuter nominatives with Latin labels, right column of genitives with their own labels. Catchword "Futu-" at lower right.

main_text.head: INFINITIVVS.
PARTICIPIVM.
main_text.l: Infinitum a. | ὁ σαλθεὶς | τοῦ σαλθέντος.
Infinitum b. | ὁ σαλεὶς | τοῦ σαλέντος.

page.notes: The left column labels are printed in italic and the Greek is in an older type face; several Greek forms are uncertain and are not marked individually, notably the Præsens infinitive and the accent marks. The Latin row labels "Præsens", "Perfectum", "Infinitum a." and "Infinitum b." appear both as row labels and as participle headings. The first infinitive line carries [?] for doubtful reading. Left-column labels for the participle table ("Præsens.", "Perfectum.", "Infinitus 1.", "Infinitus 2.") appear in the scan as "Infinitu 1." and "Infinitu 2." and are not reproduced in the lines above; the participle table's row labels Infinitus 1 and Infinitus 2 were not carried over.
